case_expansion: Categories are design inventory, not a collected test count. Each required boundary/vector must reach its own test-body behavior assertion as a distinct collected method; no skipped, failed-subtest, import/setup, or missing-API qualification. Schema expansion and actual IDs must be reviewed before entry.

expected_outcomes.reason: No tests authored or executed. Expected outcomes and fingerprints require valid T010-based fixtures and observed body assertions; no synthetic failure is accepted.

canonical_vector.serialization: UTF-8; sorted object keys; compact separators; ensure_ascii=false; finite values only; no trailing LF; Unicode code-point path order; no Unicode normalization.

exact_verifier: Use existing scripts/task_outcomes.py with ordered exact case IDs, pass/assertion outcomes and assertion fingerprints, approved discovery argv, deadlines and exact tool/input revisions. Freeze the executable matrix outside the checked root after accepted source is sealed, avoiding a self-referential snapshot. Approve matrix_argv output and its checks digest separately; --matrix-approved is supplied approval evidence, never authenticated identity. Require all implemented cases and the five pre-existing CI retained reds to match their exact baseline policy. Any new extra/missing case, unexpected green, unrelated failure, skip, import/setup error, timeout or check mutation blocks.
ci_policy: Do not edit docs/development/ci-acceptance.json, scripts/check_ci.py or scripts/task_outcomes.py. Preserve the existing five retained assertion cases without reclassifying T010/T017/T023 migrations as completed. No broad raw-suite waiver.
